body:
I must say that I'm not sure I grasp the wholeness of the problem, so bear with me. I feel that if we need to work around a behaviour implemented as a connector using a new variable that will used only in one widget, we need a new connector.

In any case, the extension of a connector should be consistent with its role. If it's the case that's fine with me. Do you have an example of the API that you want to implement?

PS : http://explosm.net/comics/3902/
